description.value: You can tap deeper into the natural music of the world and use its magic to turn your performances from mere artistry to overwhelming power. This magic can turn against those who watch you, allowing you better control of their emotions. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Calm], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Laughing Fit], or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Stupefy] as an occult innate spell. You choose which spell you cast each time you use this ability.
